name: no-wallet bootstrap documented
text: The published discovery documents never name /v1/onramp/address, so an agent with no Nano address cannot derive the first call that would give it one.

name: onboard_id handoff named
text: Even if the on-ramp call were named, nothing tells the agent that the POST /ask it enables takes onboard_id instead of an asker address.

name: exists in both documents
text: llms.txt is where a text-reading agent lands; agent.json is where a parser lands. A path documented in only one is invisible to half the arrivals.

name: observable end to end
text: The claim must be falsifiable: run the documented calls against the live API and get a 201, not a sentence saying it would work.
